# Code Anchors: Close-and-Distill Command

- `utils/close-epic.sh` — the command: the single-repo role check, the pull-request state and merge-readiness checks, the unattended post-merge conformance run read back from the published verdict and the shipped record, the interactive close, and the distill stage handed to the shipped distill command with the background option, harness and permission mode.
- `utils/codex/close-epic.sh` — the codex entry point that pins the harness and runs the same shared script.
- `components/commands/nxs.close.md` — the hand-off option: close writes the note only after the epic issue is closed and the distillation branch is pushed, and tells the lead to end the session.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/close-epic.spec.ts` — pins the command's refusals, merge checks, stage order, and the distill stage running through the shipped command.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/close-handoff.spec.ts` — pins close's hand-off option and the note it writes only on full success.
